title: The Nutcracker 2026 - December 20, 2pm
seo_title: The Nutcracker 2026 at Landers Theatre, Springfield MO
description: Springfield Ballet presents the holiday classic The Nutcracker as part of its 50th anniversary celebration. This performance is Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 2:00 PM at the Landers Theatre, 311 E Walnut St in Springfield, MO. The run lasts December 17-21, 2026, and each show is about two hours, including a 20 minute intermission.
